extended_messages.sf: // Extended test messages for struct-frame code generation framework
// Tests for message IDs > 255 (require extended profiles with pkg_id)
// Also tests for extended payloads > 255 bytes (require 2-byte length field)
// These messages are only compatible with extended profiles:
// - profile_bulk (BasicExtended): supports extended msg_id and extended payload
// - profile_network (BasicExtendedMultiSystemStream): supports extended msg_id and extended payload

comments: // Fixed-size message carrying a string array whose max_size > 255. The count
// prefix is 2 bytes here too, and the fixed pack/unpack path must agree with
// it: writing a 1-byte count shifts every following field by one and does not
// even compile in languages whose count field is a 16-bit type.
// >255 -> 2-byte count prefix
labels.name: labels

leading_comments: // Fixed-size message carrying a string array whose max_size > 255. The count
// prefix is 2 bytes here too, and the fixed pack/unpack path must agree with
// it: writing a 1-byte count shifts every following field by one and does not
// even compile in languages whose count field is a 16-bit type.
ExtendedFixedStringArray.name: ExtendedFixedStringArray

comments: // Extended Message ID Tests (msgid > 255)
// Three representative IDs cover the full range: boundary (256), mid (1000), high (4000).
// Message with ID 256 - tests minimum extended ID (just above 255)
leading_comments: // Extended Message ID Tests (msgid > 255)
// Three representative IDs cover the full range: boundary (256), mid (1000), high (4000).
// Message with ID 256 - tests minimum extended ID (just above 255)
ExtendedIdMessage10.name: ExtendedIdMessage10

comments: // Message with ID 1000 - tests mid-range extended ID
leading_comments: // Message with ID 1000 - tests mid-range extended ID
ExtendedIdMessage2.name: ExtendedIdMessage2

comments: // Message with ID 4000 - tests high extended ID with 64-bit fields
leading_comments: // Message with ID 4000 - tests high extended ID with 64-bit fields
ExtendedIdMessage9.name: ExtendedIdMessage9

comments: // A >255 bounded array as the *last* field. The copy cap in the fixed-size
// serializer is derived from the field size minus its count prefix; getting
// that prefix width wrong writes one byte past the end of the message buffer
// instead of harmlessly into the next field, where a following field's own
// write would paper over it.
// >255 -> 2-byte count prefix, last field
payload.name: payload

leading_comments: // A >255 bounded array as the *last* field. The copy cap in the fixed-size
// serializer is derived from the field size minus its count prefix; getting
// that prefix width wrong writes one byte past the end of the message buffer
// instead of harmlessly into the next field, where a following field's own
// write would paper over it.
ExtendedTrailingLargeArray.name: ExtendedTrailingLargeArray

comments: // Variable message with bounded fields whose max_size > 255, forcing 2-byte
// count/length prefixes in the variable encoding. Regression cover for the
// encoder/decoder/serialized_size prefix-width agreement: a 1-byte read on a
// 2-byte prefix corrupts every following field.
// >255 -> 2-byte length prefix
big_label.name: big_label

comments: // >255 -> 2-byte count prefix
big_telemetry.name: big_telemetry

leading_comments: // Variable message with bounded fields whose max_size > 255, forcing 2-byte
// count/length prefixes in the variable encoding. Regression cover for the
// encoder/decoder/serialized_size prefix-width agreement: a 1-byte read on a
// 2-byte prefix corrupts every following field.
ExtendedVariableLargeArray.name: ExtendedVariableLargeArray

comments: // Variable Length Message Tests for Extended IDs (msgid: 802)
// Variable message with extended ID and single bounded array (msgid: 802)
// Up to 250 bytes
telemetry_data.name: telemetry_data

leading_comments: // Variable Length Message Tests for Extended IDs (msgid: 802)
// Variable message with extended ID and single bounded array (msgid: 802)
ExtendedVariableSingleArray.name: ExtendedVariableSingleArray

comments: // Variable message carrying string arrays, at both prefix widths. Exercises
// the variable-encoding path for repeated strings, which is distinct from the
// primitive-array and single-string paths next to it.
// >255 -> 2-byte count prefix
big_tags.name: big_tags

comments: // 1-byte count prefix
tags.name: tags

leading_comments: // Variable message carrying string arrays, at both prefix widths. Exercises
// the variable-encoding path for repeated strings, which is distinct from the
// primitive-array and single-string paths next to it.
ExtendedVariableStringArray.name: ExtendedVariableStringArray
